title: A noisy step detector
hook: Two stated cases: explore the false-positive rate in one hidden-step update.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the false-positive rate in one hidden-step update affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the false-positive rate in one hidden-step update in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
